name: Lustful Voyage
source:
Prepare to enter the pirate world of lust, corruption, cheating, and envy as the protagonist tries to maintain his relationships and as other pirates compete for the hearts and desires of the beautiful women on board.

Will he succeed in fending them off, or will he let them take their share of the booty?

[From [url=https://scallywaggames.itch.io/lustful-voyage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
准备进入充满欲望、腐败、欺骗和嫉妒的海盗世界，主角试图维持自己的人际关系，而其他海盗则争夺船上美女的芳心和欲望。

他会成功击退他们，还是会让他们分享战利品？

[来自[url=https://scallywaggames.itch.io/lustful-voyage]Itch.io[/url]]
